notes.title: 1.1 Released! - Big Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]The latest version of VR Baseball is available NOW![/h1]

The game has been rebuilt with [b]new graphics[/b], a much larger stadium, and even a [b]new[/b] game [b]mode[/b]!

Leaderboards are in, achievements were expanded, and it's been filled with lots of extra [b]FUN[/b]!

Hop in and [b]play today[/b]!
